No dividends paid: Petrobras posted net losses in 2015-2017, so no distributions to Union
Petrobras transferred ~R$1.2bn to Union (initial dividend resumption after 2015-2017 loss years). Petrobras total dividend declared for FY2018 small.

Tesouro Nacional reported total Union dividends of R$20.8bn in 2019 (vs R$6.6bn in 2020). Petrobras was a major contributor but not the sole one (BNDES/Caixa/Banco do Brasil also paid). Petrobras-specific share estimated ~R$7.7bn for FY2018 distribution. Medium confidence due to lack of exact line-item breakdown.
Petrobras paid R$10.3bn total dividends from FY2020 results; Union received ~R$3.2bn (sources note this was ~12x less than R$37.3bn for FY2021 results). Reduced due to COVID-19.

Petrobras paid R$101.4bn total from FY2021 results (record at the time, lucro de R$106.7bn); Union (28.67% economic interest + voting majority) received R$37.3bn. Mostly paid through 2022. Multiple sources confirm.

Petrobras distributed R$215.7bn from FY2022 results (record, more than double 2021); Union share ~R$79bn (approx 28.67% economic + voting share allocation). 2Q22 alone: R$32.1bn to Union of R$87.8bn total. CNN reports nearly 1000% YoY increase in transfers to government.
